name: Theca cell
short_description: Steroidogenic stromal cell forming the outer capsule (theca interna + externa) of a growing ovarian follicle; under LH stimulation it makes androgens that the neighbouring granulosa cells aromatize into estrogen.

textbook.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; round-to-polygonal cutaway cell with a large euchromatic nucleus showing two nucleoli, a dense tangled mesh of smooth ER tubules dominating the cytoplasm, numerous mitochondria with visible tubular/looped cristae, several pale lipid droplets, a distinct Golgi stack, a stippled rough-ER/ribosome patch, a flap-like basal lamina at one edge with an adjoining capillary and blurred RBC-like context outside the cell; muted desaturated educational palette, thin clean outlines, dark charcoal background, no text/border; matches the science reference and the house textbook look; used as SVG base)
